title: Automated Logistics Invoice Processing
business: Logistics and freight forwarding companies managing thousands of paper-based shipping manifests and invoices.
problem: Manual data entry of complex shipping tables and key-value pairs from inconsistent vendor documents causes significant operational delays and high error rates.
solution: Azure Document Intelligence in Foundry Tools automates the extraction of text, tables, and specific document fields, transforming unstructured physical documents into structured digital data for downstream ERP integration.
steps: Configure a Document Intelligence resource in the Azure portal.
Select a prebuilt model or train a custom model to recognize specific shipping manifest layouts.
Submit document images or PDFs to the service endpoint via API.
Parse the returned JSON output to map extracted key-value pairs and table rows to database schemas.
Validate extracted data against existing purchase order records.
outcome: Increased processing speed and improved data accuracy by reducing human intervention in the document ingestion pipeline.
limitation: The service may struggle with extremely low-resolution scans or highly distorted document layouts, which requires implementing pre-processing checks to verify image quality before submission.
